Third-party software in chyp-rs builds
======================================

The chyp-rs CLI binary (native, and the WASI module
target/wasm32-wasip1/wasm/chyp-rs.wasm) and the wasm bundle (pkg/) statically
link the Rust standard library and the Rust crates below. Crates used only at build time
(procedural macros and their dependencies: wasm-bindgen-macro,
wasm-bindgen-macro-support, proc-macro2, quote, syn, bumpalo, rustversion)
are not part of any of these artifacts. unicode-ident is also a dependency of
wasm-bindgen-shared, but only through an identifier check the bundle never
calls, so none of its code is in the bundle.

Crates under "MIT OR Apache-2.0" are used under the Apache License,
Version 2.0, whose text is in LICENSE; none of them has a NOTICE file.
memchr ("Unlicense OR MIT") is used under the Unlicense. zmij is under the
MIT license only; its notice follows.

Linked into the CLI (native and WASI) and the wasm bundle:
  serde_json 1.0.154   MIT OR Apache-2.0
  serde_core 1.0.229   MIT OR Apache-2.0   (Erick Tryzelaar, David Tolnay)
  itoa 1.0.18          MIT OR Apache-2.0   (David Tolnay)
  memchr 2.8.3         Unlicense OR MIT    (Andrew Gallant, bluss)
  zmij 1.0.23          MIT                 (David Tolnay)

Linked into the wasm bundle only:
  wasm-bindgen 0.2.129         MIT OR Apache-2.0   (The wasm-bindgen Developers)
  wasm-bindgen-shared 0.2.129  MIT OR Apache-2.0   (The wasm-bindgen Developers)
  cfg-if 1.0.5                 MIT OR Apache-2.0   (Alex Crichton)
  once_cell 1.21.4             MIT OR Apache-2.0   (Aleksey Kladov)

The JavaScript glue pkg/chyp_rs.js is generated by the wasm-bindgen CLI 0.2.129
(MIT OR Apache-2.0).

All of them also contain the Rust standard library (core, alloc, std; in
the wasm bundle also dlmalloc, compiler_builtins and rustc-demangle),
Copyright The Rust Project Developers, used under the Apache License, Version
2.0 (it is Apache-2.0 OR MIT). Its Unicode data tables (library/core/src/unicode)
are under the Unicode License v3, Copyright (C) 1991-2024 Unicode, Inc.; that
licence's text follows zmij's below. The Rust toolchain's
share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT-library.html lists the standard library's notices in
full.

The WASI module also contains wasi-libc (https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-libc),
linked from the Rust toolchain's self-contained wasm32-wasip1 libc.a. wasi-libc
is under "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT" and is used
under the Apache License, Version 2.0. It contains third-party portions under
their own licences: musl libc (MIT) and cloudlibc (BSD-2-Clause), whose
notices follow the Unicode licence below, and dlmalloc (CC0, no notice
required).
